## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable, farseeing, and clever manager who handles her own affairs while frequently involving herself in those of others. Notably inquisitive, curious, and observant, she keeps a sharp eye on everything that passes, rarely letting anything escape her notice. Though she can be bossy, critical, and compulsively corrective toward people of all ages, she possesses a kind, generous heart and excels at sewing. She is an outspoken, matter-of-fact, and somewhat gossipy woman who loves giving advice and holds strong opinions, including a prejudice against [Yankees](../codex/factions.md#yankee) and a firm opposition to women's higher education, play-acting, and writing fiction. A tender, patient nurse to her husband, she is also a pessimistic judge of human nature who holds strict religious beliefs.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde had brought up ten children and buried two, married at eighteen, and lived as [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years without a quarrel. Having knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts, she eventually broke up housekeeping to devote more time to church affairs. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) planned to adopt an orphan boy, Rachel strongly disapproved and warned her against the decision. After meeting the young orphan girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Rachel offended her with blunt remarks about her red hair, leading to a fiery confrontation; she later completely forgiven [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after receiving a dramatic apology and gifted her flowers. She went on to advise [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) study at home when she refused to return to school, assisted [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) in sewing a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) win over [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) after a blunder at the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) home. Rachel eventually approved of Anne's growth, joined in praising her entrance examination success, and later provided [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with local gossip, reports of Anthony Pye's respect for Anne's teaching, and commentary on community matters. Following the passing of her husband, [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Rachel moved into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). In her new home, she helped establish house rules for the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and remained a familiar presence on the porch discussing local events and village gossip.

## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Initial hostility arose between Rachel and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after Rachel made blunt, offensive remarks about Anne's hair and appearance, provoking a passionate outburst from the young girl. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology, Rachel completely forgave her and gave her flowers, ending their feud. Rachel subsequently acted as an advisor regarding Anne's upbringing, offering counsel to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on Anne's schooling and later speaking with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went to apologize to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are longstanding neighbors and close friends who frequently visit each other to discuss local happenings, despite having different personalities. Rachel often voices strong opinions or advice regarding Marilla's household, such as warning her against adopting an orphan boy or suggesting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) study at home. Following the death of Rachel's husband, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites Rachel to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with her.
